text:
omar: Heads up — NeptuneHealth just flagged their March invoice. Looks like we double-counted reserved vCPU for a short autoscale window. Customer wants a credit; they estimated $14,200. @lisa.f can you confirm the meter lines and do we have precedent for same-day manual credits? Invoice: https://app.redwood.com/invoices/INV-20250322

billing-bot: Invoice INV-20250322 generated 2025-03-22T08:14Z. Line items: reserved-cpu x2 (2025-03-01 to 2025-03-05) + overage. Trace id: b3f4-9a2c.

lisa.f: I'm pulling the usage now. Can you drop the customer org id? I'll check quotas and whether the reserved CPU was double-billed due to a job migration.

omar: org: neptune-health (org_8765). We saw a spike between 03/02 02:00-03:00 UTC when they migrated pods across zones.

matt: I see a known issue — autoscaler recorded both old and new node groups during rolling migration when API returned stale state. We patched it 2025-03-05. Logging:
```
2025-03-02T02:14Z autoscaler: duplicated_capacity=true nodegroup:ng-ky-1 -> ng-ky-2
```

lisa.f: OK confirmed. That double-count shows as two reserved-cpu lines on the invoice. Amount to credit: $14,200 (customer calc matches ours). I'll create a manual credit memo. Need approvals: finance approval + CS sign-off.

jess: CS approves — they were impacted, apology sent, offered 1-month free dedicated capacity as goodwill. :thumbsup:

lisa.f: @finance Approving for $14,200 credit to INV-20250322 and create CM-2025-032. Change log: manual_adj by lisa.f. I'll run the audit and attach reason. ETA for posting: EOD today.

calvin: finance approves. Please include ledger tag `manual_credit:neptune_health_migration` and route to AR for posting. :white_check_mark:

omar: Thanks all. I'll notify customer once credit posts.
